sloka: वायुसूनोः सुहृत्त्वेन भक्त्या परमया च सः ।शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्यो ऽपि लघुत्वमगमत् कपेः ।। ६.५९.१२० ।।।।
transliteration: vāyusūnoḥ suhṛttvena bhaktyā paramayā ca saḥ ।śatrūṇāmaprakampyo 'pi laghutvamagamat kapeḥ ।। 6.59.120 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.
